_metadata.method: Second-pass inference using 497-entry consolidated glyph map, cross-reference with English guide (guide_full.txt latin-1), prior inferred files (r38-r47), and Japanese language/RPG domain knowledge. Binary parsed as big-endian uint16.

497.note: Mapped as 出 in msg_glyph_map but r44 prior inference had 定 (設定). Context in r42 supports 出 (出発). Both usages possible if size variant.

5.evidence: R45 M184: standalone single glyph after exclamation context. Likely a musical note or decorative symbol used at end of dialog.

26.evidence: R45 M119-121: 依頼人[26] = 依頼人： (Client:), 報[1000][26] = 報酬： (Reward:), 期日[26] = 期日： (Deadline:). Fullwidth colon as label separator in order display.

109.evidence: R45 M104: standalone, likely percent sign in shop management stats display.

306.evidence: R44 M6: 決して迷[306]らない = 決して迷宮らない. In Wizardry context 迷宮 = labyrinth. However grammar is awkward. Could also be 惑 forming 迷惑 (trouble). LOW confidence.

307.evidence: R44 M4: [307][606]き自動人[759] = 永久き自動人形? More likely 古(furu)き. But 永遠 (eternal) fits Automata lore. Tentative.

316.evidence: R44 M8: [316][776] = 職業 (occupation/class). R39 confirms: 職業の使いでつけかえられません. Standard RPG class term.

318.evidence: R44 M8: 加[318]して = 加算して (add/calculate). Adding magic stones to strengthen Automata involves calculation/accumulation.

320.evidence: R44 M44/51: 信[354][320] = 信仰心 (faith/piety). R45 M70: 安[320] = 安心 (peace of mind). R42 also inferred 320=心 in 心身. Standard Wizardry attribute.

354.evidence: R44 M44/51: 信[354][320] = 信仰心 (faith). 信仰 (shinkou) is the standard Japanese term for the FTH/WIS attribute in Wizardry.

356.evidence: R45 M43: [356][672]がわかって|スッキリしたべ = 正体がわかって (identity revealed). 正体 (shoutai) = true identity. Fits item identification context at Vigger Shop.

388.evidence: R45 M26: [955][388]の品 = 呪いの品 (cursed item). R44 M4: [391][388] appears in automata context. 呪い (noroi) = curse, central to Vigger Shop uncursing and Automata chip creation.

391.evidence: R44 M4: [422][391][388][617] = context of ancient times. Possibly 古(furu) as in 古い (old).

402.evidence: R45 M52-54,66,71,93-97,141-150: [402]店 appears extensively = 支店 (branch store). Guide confirms branch stores are a major Vigger Shop expansion feature.

417.evidence: R44 M8,27: [417][924][672]チップ = ○○○チップ (chip type). Could be body part names for Automata chips (brain/body/hand/arm/leg). Tentative.

422.evidence: R44 M4: [422][391][388][617]の[915][916] = description of ancient era. 遥か (haruka = distant/ancient) fits Automata lore. Very tentative.

434.evidence: R45 M83: 仲間にこのオーダーを[434][936]しますか = 紹介しますか (will you introduce/refer this order?). R45 M116: [434][936] as standalone menu label. 紹介 = introduction/referral.

436.evidence: R45 M90: 使いが殿かれ[436]け[941]った = curse was released and slipped off. [436]け = 抜け (slip out). Consistent with r39 inference.

489.evidence: R44 M8: オートマター[489]息 = unusual compound. Could be 復息 or 一息. Context unclear.

494.evidence: R45 M70: いつでも[494]めたら = いつでも休めたら (if you can rest anytime). R45 M166: [494]けい所 = 休憩所 (rest area). R45 M194: [494]んでいきますか = 休んでいきますか (will you rest?). R42 confirms 494=休.

539.evidence: R44 M6: 決して迷○らない[539]であり = ○○な存在であり (an existence that never...). 存在 (sonzai = existence) fits Automata description.

581.evidence: R45 M38: 誰の持ち[581]を = 誰の持ち物を (whose belongings). R45 M26: [955][388]の品[581]持ってるべ = 呪いの品物持ってるべ. R45 M67: 持ち[581]のかたづけ = 持ち物のかたづけ (organizing belongings). R43 also inferred 581=物. Overwhelmingly 物 (mono = thing/object).

582.evidence: R44 M46/53: [582][719]度 = 敏捷度 (agility stat). Standard Wizardry AGI attribute name in Japanese.

597.evidence: R44 M11: 回[597] = 回数 (number of times). R44 M22: 騎士団と[597]を = 騎士団と数を (knight order and number). R45 M35: アイテムの[597]が足りません = アイテムの数が足りません (not enough items count). R45 M189: 作入[597]を決めてください = number to create.

606.evidence: R44 M4: [307][606]き自動人[759] = 永久き自動人形 (eternal automaton). 永久 (eikyuu) = eternity.

617.evidence: R44 M4: [422][391][388][617]の[915][916] = ancient era description. 昔 (mukashi = long ago) tentative.

627.evidence: R45 M137: [627]回復品 = 呪回復品? More likely 状(態)回復品 or similar. Context: category of recovery items at Vigger Shop. Could be a different character. Tentative.

642.evidence: R45 M29/33: 店の[962][642]を = 店の評判を (shop's reputation). 評判 (hyouban) = reputation, matches guide: REPUTATION field in shop management.

646.evidence: R45 M67: いつでも[646]取できれば = いつでも買取できれば (if you can buy anytime). R45 M85: [646]い取り = 買い取り (purchase/buyback). R45 M112: 10gでしか[646]わねえ = 10Gでしか買わねえ (won't buy for more than 10G). R45 M133-138: [646]取解除中 = 買取解除中 (buyback unlocked). Vigger Shop core function.

671.evidence: R44 M11: [671]に価けていれば = context about treasure acquisition. Could be 磨 or 研. LOW confidence.

672.evidence: R44 M8/27: [417][924][672]チップ = ○○体チップ? Automata chip names. R45 M43: [356][672] = 正体 (true identity). 体 fits both: body chip and identity.

687.evidence: R45 M131: さい[687]大[905]出し中 = 歳末大売出し中 (year-end big sale). But 687 could be 期 as in 期末. Alternatively 歳(sai) = year. With 687 between さい and 大, it reads: さい期大売出し. More likely the whole word is 歳末 where [687]=末 (end). Revising: 687=末.

696.evidence: R44 M45/52: 生[696]力 = 生命力 (vitality/life force). Standard Wizardry VIT/VIG attribute. R44 M9: 獲得[696]中 = 獲得命中 (acquisition hit rate). 命 confirmed.

699.evidence: R45 M9: アルバイトを[699]うってのは = アルバイトを雇うってのは (hiring part-timers). R45 M100: [699]息しますか = 雇用しますか? Actually this might be 休. R45 M185: 今は[699]えません = 今は雇えません (can't hire now). R45 M186: しばらく[699]えないだよ = しばらく雇えないだよ (can't hire for a while). R46 confirms 699=雇.

704.evidence: R44 M11: [758]方獲得も[704]能です = ○方獲得も可能です (obtaining XX is also possible). 可能 (kanou = possible).

717.evidence: R44 M43/50: 知[717] = 知恵 (wisdom/intelligence). Standard Wizardry INT attribute in Japanese. Clear from stat change menu context.

719.evidence: R44 M46/53: [582][719]度 = 敏捷度 (agility). [582]=敏, [719]=捷. Standard Wizardry AGI attribute.

721.evidence: R44 M47/54: 幸[721]度 = 幸運度 (luck). Standard Wizardry LCK attribute.

723.evidence: R44 M9: 獲得[696]中[723] = 獲得命中率? R45 M182: 生戻[723] = 生命? This is confusing with 696=命. Could be a size variant or different character. In R44 context: 中[723] after 命 could be 率. Revising: 723=率 (rate/percentage).

724.evidence: R44 M10: [724]消力 = 耐消力 (endurance against consumption). R44 M12: [724]消力や回数力 = 耐消力. 耐 (tai = endurance/resistance) fits Automata stat context.

725.evidence: R44 M12/13: 回[725]力 = 回復力 (recovery power). 725 as size variant of 428/413=復. Fits knight order stat effect descriptions.

738.evidence: R45 M55-63: アイテム２０[738]まで = アイテム20個まで (up to 20 items). Counter word for items in warehouse expansion context. Guide confirms warehouse capacity increases in increments.

752.evidence: R45 M75: 探索に[752]かわせて = 探索に向かわせて (send on exploration). 向かわせる = to dispatch/send toward.

758.evidence: R44 M11: [758]方獲得も可能です = 双方獲得も可能です (acquiring both is possible). 双方 (souhou = both sides). Alternatively 先方 or 片方.

759.evidence: R44 M4: 自動人[759] = 自動人形 (automaton/automata). 人形 (ningyou = doll/puppet) is the literal Japanese word for automata.

772.evidence: R45 M180: 探索隊[772] = 探索隊派(遣) = search party dispatch. 派遣 (haken = dispatch). Alternatively 772=編 forming 探索隊編(成).

776.evidence: R44 M8: [316][776] = 職業 (occupation/class). R45 M94: 業[967]変更 = 業種変更 (change business type). R39 confirms. Standard term.

781.evidence: R44 M8: [724][781]を加算して = 耐久を加算して (adding durability). 耐久 (taikyuu = durability). Consistent with Automata strengthening.

782.evidence: R44 M10: 獲得[782]騎士に対する = 獲得時騎士 (at time of acquisition, to the knight). Tentative.

799.evidence: R45 M152: [947][873][799]リスト = 増設先リスト (expansion destination list). R45 M154: 物転[799]リスト = 移転先リスト (relocation destination list). 先 (saki = destination).

852.evidence: R44 M3: 騎士団を[852]りましょう = 騎士団を造りましょう (let's create). R44 M16: いくつ[852]りますか = how many to create. R44 M40: チップを[852]りますか = create chips. R45 M52: [402]店を[852]るか = 支店を造るか (create a branch?). Manufacturing/creation sense for Automata and shop expansion.

853.evidence: R44 M3: 集ったく[853]を = collected medals/merit. R44 M15: く[853]の組み編わせ = medal combinations for formation. R44 M36-37: 編隊く[853]が足りません = formation medals insufficient. 勲 (kun = merit/medal) as formation resource. Could also be 勲章(kunshou) truncated.

873.evidence: R45 M55-63: [873]けるようになる = 置けるようになる (will be able to place/store). Actually: 設ける = to establish. R45 M152: [947][873] = 増設 (expansion). R45 M165-166: [947][873] as verb = 増設する (to expand). Revising to 設.

893.evidence: R45 M86: [893]び替え = 並び替え (rearrange/sort). Standard menu term for sorting items. R40 also inferred 893=並.

898.evidence: R44 M26: 一[898]のようです = 一杯のようです (seems to be full). いっぱい (ippai = full). R43 inferred 898=杯.

905.evidence: R45 M20-21: 何を[905]ってくれるだよ = 何を売ってくれるだよ (what will you sell?). R45 M24: はよ[905]ってくれよう = はよ売ってくれよう (hurry up and sell). R45 M106-107: [905][1023]しますか/しました = 売却しますか (will you sell/sold). R45 M131: 大[905]出し = 大売出し (big sale). Core Vigger Shop sell function.

914.evidence: R44 M3: 騎士から[914]ったく勲を = 騎士から集った勲を (medals gathered from knights). 集める (atsumeru = to gather/collect).

915.evidence: R44 M4: の[915][916] = の遺産 (legacy/heritage). Automata are the legacy of ancient elven civilization per guide.

916.evidence: R44 M4: [915][916] = 遺産 (legacy). Paired with 915.

917.evidence: R44 M4: [917][918]に[919]ちぬ = 歳月に朽ちぬ (undecayed by time). 歳月 (saigetsu = passage of time). Fits Automata as eternal beings.

918.evidence: R44 M4: [917][918] = 歳月 (time/years). Paired with 917.

919.evidence: R44 M4: [919]ちぬ = 朽ちぬ (never decaying). 朽ちる (kuchiru = to decay/rot). Negated form: does not decay. Perfect for Automata description.

921.evidence: R44 M6: [921][922]な[923]士です = 忠実な戦士です (a loyal warrior). 忠実 (chuujitsu = faithful/loyal). Guide: Automata = loyal friend and soldier.

922.evidence: R44 M6: [921][922] = 忠実 (faithful). Paired with 921.

923.evidence: R44 M6: [923]士 = 戦士 (warrior). 286=戦 already in map; 923 is likely a size variant. Guide: Automata described as close-combat weapons.

924.evidence: R44 M8/27: [417][924][672]チップ = ○車体チップ? Automata chip naming. Very tentative. Could be part of chip category name (brain/body/hand/arm/leg per guide).

933.evidence: R45 M68: オメェの[933][581]をいつでも = オメェの荷物をいつでも (your luggage/cargo anytime). 荷物 (nimotsu = luggage). Fits warehouse/storage context.

936.evidence: R45 M83: [434][936]しますか = 紹介しますか (will you introduce/refer). R45 M116: [434][936] = 紹介 as menu label. 紹介 (shoukai = introduction/referral) for sharing orders with companions.

937.evidence: R45 M69: お[937]さまにも = お客さまにも (even to customers). R45 M73: [937]足がのびると = 客足がのびると (if customer traffic increases). 客 (kyaku = customer). Central to Vigger Shop operations.

940.evidence: R45 M92/96/105/125: [948][940] = 倉庫 (warehouse/storage). R45 M51: [948][940]をでっかくしてやるだよ = 倉庫をでっかくしてやるだよ (gonna make the warehouse bigger). Guide: EXTEND THE WAREHOUSE is a shop expansion option.

941.evidence: R45 M90: 使いが殿かれ[436]け[941]った = 抜け落った (slipped off and fell). 落ちる (ochiru = to fall). Size variant of 408=落. R39 also inferred 941=落.

943.evidence: R45 M68: 感[943]しろよ = 感謝しろよ (be grateful!). 感謝 (kansha = gratitude). Fits Vigger Shop orc personality.

947.evidence: R45 M93: [402]店の新[947] = 支店の新増? More likely: R45 M92/96: [948][940]の[950][954] = 倉庫の拡張. R45 M152: [947][873][799]リスト = 増設先リスト (expansion location list). R45 M165: イベント場を[947][873] = イベント場を増設 (expand event space). 増 (zou = increase) as in 増設 (expansion/addition).

948.evidence: R45 M51/92/96/105/125/193: [948][940] = 倉庫 (warehouse). 倉 (kura = storehouse). Core Vigger Shop feature.

949.evidence: R45 M68: [948][940]まで[949]ってやるだ = 倉庫まで送ってやるだ (will send to warehouse). R45 M164: [959][949]業[967] = 配送業種 (delivery business). 送る (okuru = to send).

950.evidence: R45 M55-63/92/96: [950][954] = 拡張 (expansion). いま[950][954]したら = いま拡張したら (if you expand now). Guide: EXTEND THE WAREHOUSE and EXPANSION are core shop features.

954.evidence: R45 M55-63/92/96: [950][954] = 拡張 (expansion). Paired with 950=拡. Standard game term.

955.evidence: R45 M26: [955][388]の品 = 呪いの品 (cursed item). Note: both 955 and 388 may map to 呪-related characters. 955 could be the kanji 呪 while 388 could be い(い) forming 呪い. Revising: 955=呪, and 388 needs reconsideration.

958.evidence: R45 M78/81/115/161-162: [958]品 = 納品 (delivery of goods). R45 M81: [958]品し、このオーダーを退了しますか = 納品し、このオーダーを退了しますか (deliver goods and close this order?). 納品 is the standard term for delivering ordered goods.

959.evidence: R45 M164: [959][949]業[967] = 配送業種 (delivery service type). R45 M191-192: [959][949]しますか = 配送しますか (will you ship?). 配送 (haisou = delivery/shipping).

962.evidence: R45 M29/33: 店の[962][642] = 店の評判 (shop's reputation). Guide: REPUTATION is a key shop management stat. 評判 (hyouban).

967.evidence: R45 M94: 業[967]変更 = 業種変更 (change business type). R45 M98: 業[967]を追加しますか = 業種を追加しますか (add business type?). R45 M153: 業[967]リスト = 業種リスト (business type list). 業種 (gyoushu = type of business).

1000.evidence: R45 M120: 報[1000][26] = 報酬： (Reward:). 926=酬 already in map; 1000 is likely a size variant. Label display in order information.

1023.evidence: R45 M106-107/109: [905][1023]しますか/しました = 売却しますか/しました (will you sell/sold). 売却 (baikyaku = sale/disposal). Standard commerce term.

687.evidence: R45 M131: さい[687]大売出し中 = 歳末大売出し中 (year-end big sale). 歳末 (saimatsu = year-end). Replaces initial 期 guess.

723.evidence: R44 M9: 獲得命中[723] = 獲得命中率 (acquisition hit rate). R45 M182: 生戻[723] unclear. 率 (ritsu = rate/ratio).

627.evidence: R45 M137: [627]回復品 = 状(態)回復品 = status recovery items. Revised from initial 呪 guess.

388.evidence: R45 M26: [955]呪[388]の品物 = 呪わ? No. Reconsidering: if 955=呪, then the full phrase would be 呪[388]の品物. Perhaps 388=い forming 呪い (curse noun). But 388 is in kanji range. Alternatively 955 is not 呪 and 388 alone = 呪. Keeping 388=呪 as primary mapping and revising 955.
